question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

The palace was admired for its grand **columns**.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"columns"** refers to a vertical structure or pillar, typically used in architecture to support or decorate a building. (स्तंभ)

 
 
• **Example:** The ancient temple was adorned with intricately designed marble columns.
 
 
 
• In the context of Option 2, **"columns"** refers to a section of a newspaper or magazine, which is a homonym of the word "columns" (used for architectural pillars). (अखबार में स्तंभ)
 
 
• **Example:** The editor's opinion column in the newspaper gained widespread attention.
 
 
 
• Homonyms are words that have the same spelling or pronunciation but have different meanings.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** The architect restored ancient columns. (प्राचीन स्तंभ) - This refers to the architectural meaning of "columns" as vertical structures or pillars.

 
 
• **Example:** The architect ensured the ancient columns were preserved during the restoration.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** Marble columns lined the hall. (संगमरमर के स्तंभ) - Again, this refers to the architectural meaning of "columns" as structural pillars.
 
 
• **Example:** The grand hall was made more elegant by the addition of marble columns.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** Visitors sketched the palace columns. (महल के स्तंभ) - This also refers to the architectural meaning of "columns."
 
 
• **Example:** Tourists loved sketching the intricately carved palace columns.
 
 

3b:T9d8,

The correct answer is **Option 1**.
